description: Auth feature: create the useAuth hook (src/features/auth/index.js), LoginScreen, RegisterScreen, and update AppNavigator to gate the app behind authentication. This feature depends on FEAT-001 (api.js, storage.js, i18n keys). After this feature, the user can log in with a real phone/password, the token is stored, and the navigator shows the main app vs login screens based on auth state.
steps: Step 1 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/features/auth/index.js. Export default useAuth() hook with state: { user, isLoading, isAuthenticated, error }. On mount: sets isLoading=true, calls storage.getToken(), if token exists calls api.auth.me() to validate, sets user + isAuthenticated=true on success, on failure (401 or network) calls storage.removeToken() + storage.removeRefreshToken() and stays unauthenticated; sets isLoading=false. login(phone, password): sets isLoading=true, clears error, calls api.auth.login(phone, password), on success calls storage.setToken(accessToken) + storage.setRefreshToken(refreshToken), sets user + isAuthenticated=true, sets isLoading=false, returns true; on failure sets error message, sets isLoading=false, returns false. register(fullName, phone, password): same pattern as login but calls api.auth.register. logout(): calls api.auth.logout() (ignore errors), removes both tokens, sets user=null + isAuthenticated=false. Returns { user, isLoading, isAuthenticated, error, login, register, logout }.

Step 2 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/screens/Login/LoginScreen.js. Layout (top to bottom): SafeAreaView with background colors.background; large 'FORMO' text in colors.accent as logo header; t('welcome') as title, t('welcomeSub') as subtitle; TextInput for phone (keyboardType='phone-pad', placeholder t('phone'), styled with dark surface background + border + colors.accent focus border); TextInput for password (secureTextEntry with show/hide toggle Pressable using Text '👁'/'🔒'); error Text in red (#E8543F) shown only when error is non-null; Button with label = auth.isLoading ? t('loggingIn') : t('loginButton'), disabled when isLoading, onPress calls auth.login(phone, password), on success calls onLogin() prop; Pressable link at bottom t('noAccount') that calls onRegister() prop. Use KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView wrapper. Full StyleSheet.create, all colors from theme.js. No Alert usage.

Step 3 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/screens/Login/RegisterScreen.js. Fields: fullName (TextInput), phone (TextInput, keyboardType='phone-pad'), password (TextInput, secureTextEntry with toggle), confirmPassword (TextInput, secureTextEntry with toggle). Client-side validation before calling API: fullName non-empty, phone matches /^\+998\d{9}$/ or is 9 digits (normalize before sending), password >= 6 chars, password === confirmPassword. On validation fail set local validationError state and show as red text. On valid: call auth.register(fullName, phone, password), on success call onLogin() prop. t('registering') loading state on button. Pressable link t('haveAccount') calls onLogin() (returns to login). Same dark navy StyleSheet as LoginScreen.

Step 4 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/navigation/AppNavigator.js. Accept an 'auth' prop (the useAuth object). Add local state: const [authRoute, setAuthRoute] = useState('login'). Render logic: if auth.isLoading → return centered LoadingSpinner (full-screen View with ActivityIndicator in colors.accent); if !auth.isAuthenticated → render LoginScreen or RegisterScreen based on authRoute, passing auth as prop, onLogin=() => { /* nothing, AppNavigator re-renders when auth.isAuthenticated flips */ }, onRegister=() => setAuthRoute('register'), on RegisterScreen pass onLogin=() => setAuthRoute('login') (back link) and onRegister is onLogin() prop from auth success. After auth.isAuthenticated becomes true, render the existing main navigator content unchanged. Pass auth to ProfileScreen via existing props. Keep all existing routes, hideTabs logic, BottomTabs, and other screen props unchanged.

Step 5 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/App.js to instantiate useAuth() at the top level and pass auth to AppNavigator. Also pass auth down to be used by screens. Import useAuth from './features/auth'. Add: const auth = useAuth(); Pass auth prop to AppNavigator. This is the only change to App.js.
acceptance_criteria: src/features/auth/index.js exists and exports default useAuth function
src/screens/Login/LoginScreen.js exists with FORMO logo, phone+password fields, show/hide toggle, login button, link to register
src/screens/Login/RegisterScreen.js exists with 4 fields, validation, link back to login
AppNavigator shows LoginScreen when auth.isAuthenticated=false and auth.isLoading=false
AppNavigator shows main app content when auth.isAuthenticated=true
App.js passes auth prop to AppNavigator
npm run export:android completes with exit code 0
findings: COMPLETED. All acceptance criteria met. Verified via `npm run export:android` — Metro bundled 638 modules with exit code 0. Key facts for FEAT-003: (1) useAuth() default export from src/features/auth/index.js — returns { user, isLoading, isAuthenticated, error, login, register, logout }; (2) error field holds an i18n key string ('loginError', 'networkError', 'authError') — screens call t(auth.error) to display; (3) login(phone, password) and register(fullName, phone, password) both return boolean (true=success, false=failure); (4) logout() is async, clears both tokens from storage and sets isAuthenticated=false; (5) AppNavigator now accepts 'auth' prop and gates the whole app — main content only visible when auth.isAuthenticated=true; (6) ProfileScreen now receives auth prop via AppNavigator for logout integration; (7) LoginScreen and RegisterScreen live in src/screens/Login/ and accept { auth, t, onLogin, onRegister } props; (8) Phone normalisation in RegisterScreen converts 9-digit or spaced inputs to +998XXXXXXXXX before calling API; (9) App.js instantiates useAuth() and passes it to AppNavigator.
